$comment: The app's identity, in ONE place.
Renaming this app used to be a scavenger hunt across fifteen files, and the
last one (Notebook -> Bellanote) left main.rs calling notebook_lib::run()
after the crate had become bellanote — so src-tauri did not compile at all,
and tsc plus 1,480 tests were green through the whole thing because neither
So: this file is the source of truth, `npm run rename` rewrites every
surface from it, and tests/brand-consistency.test.ts fails when any surface
disagrees with it. Change the name HERE and run the script; do not hand-edit
`legacyWelcomeTitles` is the one field that must only ever GROW. The welcome
book's title is also the identity check that stops a second one being
seeded, so every past title has to stay listed or a rename hands existing
readers a duplicate book beside the one they have been writing in.
name: Alcove
tagline: built like a picture book — flat-drawn shelves and walls; write inside like a notebook

art.$comment: The illustration every shipped icon is rendered from. scripts/gen-icons.py cuts its baked frame to alpha and close-crops the small sizes.

$comment: Strings that contain a past app name and must survive every rename.
The script refuses to touch these and the consistency test asserts they
are still present, because each one breaks something real if it changes.
doNotRename.Notebook Script: the writing language's product name — it is not the app
doNotRename.notebook-bundle: BUNDLE_FORMAT, written into every .nbk ever exported; renaming it orphans files this build already wrote
